# CP-MEMO — CreditResearchReport Export Hard Gate

Publication is permitted only when all conditions below pass.

1. One exact run is selected and its packaged authority/catalog verify.
2. Every candidate has a disposition and every accepted live host appears in
   the provenance index.
3. Every visible module reference uses `Module ID — Module Name`.
4. Every substantive block maps to accepted upstream text or cells.
5. No output number, date, recommendation, confidence label, priority, rank,
   taxonomy, or scope exceeds its mapped upstream finding.
6. LITE content remains `SCREENING_ONLY`; conflicts remain unresolved and
   dual-attributed; Restricted content remains visibly qualified.
7. Missing `CP-5 — EvidenceTraceValidator` / `CP-5A — ResearchIntegrityQA`
   clearance is disclosed and is not a generation blocker.
8. The exact DOCX reopens, its Word structures validate, and its temporary PDF
   renders to one non-empty PNG per page.
9. A human/model with image inspection capability has reviewed every page at
   100% and found no material visual defect.
10. The target filename does not exist and publication uses an exclusive
    no-clobber operation.

Failure of any hard gate produces no published DOCX.
